diagnostics.note: Dump nonzero codes accompany successfully written unique XML and retained stdout. No nonzero native input command occurred. The first dump did not retain stdout/stderr; that gap is preserved. The self-disable tap made no business mutation.

The 55 HTTP ledger rows are helper requests only. Native network calls were not intercepted, so their HTTP status/count is not inferred from screenshots.
35 trees and screenshots are sequential captures, not simultaneous frames or a continuous recording.
Original PNG and sidecar bytes plus identity/draft preferences were retained and rehashed; no active Room database/WAL copy or whole-profile equality claim.
No install, upgrade, clear-data, force-stop, daily application input, external component action, production mutation, or deletion. Five components remained disabled in every observed A/B response.
No native link/unlink mutation, nonzero historical task-reference retention, physical-device, or whole baseline completion is claimed.
